15	package caddy
16	
17	import (
18		"encoding/json"
19		"fmt"
20		"net/http"
21		"reflect"
22		"sync"
23		"testing"
24	)
25	
26	var testCfg = []byte(`{
27				"apps": {
28					"http": {
29						"servers": {
30							"myserver": {
31								"listen": ["tcp/localhost:8080-8084"],
32								"read_timeout": "30s"
33							},
34							"yourserver": {
35								"listen": ["127.0.0.1:5000"],
36								"read_header_timeout": "15s"
37							}
38						}
39					}
40				}
41			}
42			`)
43	
44	func TestUnsyncedConfigAccess(t *testing.T) {
45		// each test is performed in sequence, so
46		// each change builds on the previous ones;
47		// the config is not reset between tests
48		for i, tc := range []struct {
49			method    string
50			path      string // rawConfigKey will be prepended
51			payload   string
52			expect    string // JSON representation of what the whole config is expected to be after the request
53			shouldErr bool
54		}{
55			{
56				method:  "POST",
57				path:    "",
58				payload: `{"foo": "bar", "list": ["a", "b", "c"]}`, // starting value
59				expect:  `{"foo": "bar", "list": ["a", "b", "c"]}`,
60			},
61			{
62				method:  "POST",
63				path:    "/foo",
64				payload: `"jet"`,
65				expect:  `{"foo": "jet", "list": ["a", "b", "c"]}`,
66			},
67			{
68				method:  "POST",
69				path:    "/bar",
70				payload: `{"aa": "bb", "qq": "zz"}`,
71				expect:  `{"foo": "jet", "bar": {"aa": "bb", "qq": "zz"}, "list": ["a", "b", "c"]}`,
72			},
73			{
74				method: "DELETE",
75				path:   "/bar/qq",
76				expect: `{"foo": "jet", "bar": {"aa": "bb"}, "list": ["a", "b", "c"]}`,
77			},
78			{
79				method:  "POST",
80				path:    "/list",
81				payload: `"e"`,
82				expect:  `{"foo": "jet", "bar": {"aa": "bb"}, "list": ["a", "b", "c", "e"]}`,
83			},
84			{
85				method:  "PUT",
86				path:    "/list/3",
87				payload: `"d"`,
88				expect:  `{"foo": "jet", "bar": {"aa": "bb"}, "list": ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"]}`,
89			},
90			{
91				method: "DELETE",
92				path:   "/list/3",
93				expect: `{"foo": "jet", "bar": {"aa": "bb"}, "list": ["a", "b", "c", "e"]}`,
94			},
95			{
96				method:  "PATCH",
97				path:    "/list/3",
98				payload: `"d"`,
99				expect:  `{"foo": "jet", "bar": {"aa": "bb"}, "list": ["a", "b", "c", "d"]}`,
100			},
101			{
102				method:  "POST",
103				path:    "/list/...",
104				payload: `["e", "f", "g"]`,
105				expect:  `{"foo": "jet", "bar": {"aa": "bb"}, "list": ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g"]}`,
106			},
107		} {
108			err := unsyncedConfigAccess(tc.method, rawConfigKey+tc.path, []byte(tc.payload), nil)
109	
110			if tc.shouldErr && err == nil {
111				t.Fatalf("Test %d: Expected error return value, but got: %v", i, err)
112			}
113			if !tc.shouldErr && err != nil {
114				t.Fatalf("Test %d: Should not have had error return value, but got: %v", i, err)
115			}
116	
117			// decode the expected config so we can do a convenient DeepEqual
118			var expectedDecoded any
119			err = json.Unmarshal([]byte(tc.expect), &expectedDecoded)
120			if err != nil {
121				t.Fatalf("Test %d: Unmarshaling expected config: %v", i, err)
122			}
123	
124			// make sure the resulting config is as we expect it
125			if !reflect.DeepEqual(rawCfg[rawConfigKey], expectedDecoded) {
126				t.Fatalf("Test %d:\nExpected:\n\t%#v\nActual:\n\t%#v",
127					i, expectedDecoded, rawCfg[rawConfigKey])
128			}
129		}
130	}
